build_TensorMask_model: build a TensorMask instance from a detectron2 config to perform instance segmentation with mask prediction
build_TensorMaskHead: build a TensorMaskHead module with classification, box regression, and mask prediction subnets from config
run_anchor_assignment: run the assignment rule to match ground truth boxes to anchor boxes using containment and centrality rules
